formula.totalInvestment: Sum inventoryCost only for verified own vehicles not marked 판매완료
formula.inventoryCapital: Sum registered inventoryLoan only for those same currently held vehicles
formula.soldVehicles: Exclude purchase price, all expenses, inventory interest and loan principal from these three capital cards
formula.currency: KRW safe integers with thousands separators; negative cash is preserved
formula.reportingMonth: Only counts/margins/charts use their existing date filters; current capital uses all own unsold vehicles

costAndFinanceSources.cost: Existing inventoryInvestmentOf: purchase price, normalized direct costs, repairs, custom costs and daily inventory interest, with existing income-tax exclusion
costAndFinanceSources.financing: Existing inventoryLoanOf(car), same effective per-vehicle principal used by inventory finance; matching ledger registrations overlay/sync through existing handlers
costAndFinanceSources.noDoubleCounting: A linked finance ledger entry and its vehicle loan are counted once through the effective vehicle amount
notIncluded: standalone finance entries without a currently held owner vehicle
